title: Verity Totem of Undying
description: Replace the default Totem of Undying with a clean, high-quality Verity-themed texture while preserving Minecraft's vanilla style. Lightweight, simple, and easy to use with any resource pack setup.
body:
# Verity Totem

Replace the default Totem of Undying with a clean, high-quality Verity-themed texture while preserving Minecraft's vanilla aesthetic.

## Features

- Replaces the Totem of Undying with Verity
- Vanilla-friendly design
- Lightweight and performance-friendly
- Compatible with survival and multiplayer
- Works alongside most resource packs

## Installation

1. Download the resource pack.
2. Move the `.zip` file into your Minecraft `resourcepacks` folder.
3. Enable the pack in **Options → Resource Packs**.
4. Place it above other packs that modify the Totem of Undying to ensure it takes priority.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition
- Compatible with most resource packs that do not also replace the Totem of Undying texture.

## Credits

Verity is the intellectual property of its original creator. This resource pack is an unofficial fan-made project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original creator.
